eir.0610 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0610.t
	desc = eir.0610.desc
	theme = war
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_conqueror
		animation = personality_bold
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_conq_ready_trigger = yes
		current_year >= 900
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_1 }
		any_ruler = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_west_germanic }
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		eir_conq_pick_1_effect = yes
		set_global_variable = eir_conq_done_1
		set_global_variable = { name = eir_conq_cooldown days = 14600 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0610.a
		stress_impact = {
			brave = minor_stress_impact_loss
			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		eir_conq_launch_1_effect = yes
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_shield_wall_modifier years = 3 }
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				has_trait = brave
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = wrathful
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0610.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			diplomacy >= 11
			has_trait = gregarious
			has_trait = honest
			}
		}
		stress_impact = {
			patient = minor_stress_impact_loss
			wrathful = minor_stress_impact_gain
			impatient = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		random_list = {
			45 = {
				desc = eir.out.c1a
				modifier = {
					add = 25
					diplomacy >= 14
				}
				add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_foreknowledge_modifier years = 4 }
				trigger_event = { id = eir.0615 days = 1000 }
			}
			55 = {
				desc = eir.out.c1b
				eir_conq_launch_1_effect = yes
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
				scope:eir_conqueror = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_conqueror_emboldened_modifier years = 4 } }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = gregarious
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = patient
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0610.c
		trigger = {
			gold >= 800
		}
		stress_impact = {
			brave = minor_stress_impact_gain
			craven = minor_stress_impact_loss
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = 800
		add_prestige = major_prestige_loss
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_conq_tributary_modifier years = 10 }

		ai_chance = {
			base = 6
			modifier = {
				add = 25
				has_trait = craven

		}

	option = {

		trigger = {
			eir_stage3_trigger = yes

		stress_impact = {

eir.0613 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0613.t
	desc = eir.0613.desc
	theme = war
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_conqueror
		animation = personality_bold
	}

	trigger = {
		has_global_variable = eir_conq_active
		is_at_war = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		var:eir_conq_lord_var ?= {
			save_scope_as = eir_conqueror
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0613.a
		stress_impact = {
			callous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			sadistic = minor_stress_impact_loss
			compassionate = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		random_sub_realm_county = {
			limit = { is_coastal_county = yes }
			add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_scorched_earth_modifier years = 3 }
		}
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_hill_war_modifier years = 3 }
		add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_hunter track = hunter value = 20 }
		add_stress = minor_stress_gain
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = callous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0613.b
		trigger = {
			gold >= 300
		}
		stress_impact = {
			greedy = minor_stress_impact_loss
			generous = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = 300
		spawn_army = {
			levies = 0
			men_at_arms = {
				type = armored_footmen
				stacks = 5
			}
			location = capital_province
			origin = capital_province
			inheritable = no
			name = eir_gallowglass_company_name
		}
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
	}

			base = 30

				has_trait = zealous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0613.d

			OR = {
			prowess >= 12

			}

		stress_impact = {

eir.0614 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_active }
			if = {
				limit = { is_at_war = no }
				eir_conq_clear_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event = { id = eir.0614 days = 365 }
			}
		}
	}
}

eir.0615 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		eir_conq_pick_1_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:eir_conqueror
				exists = scope:eir_conq_title
				eir_conq_target_trigger = yes
				NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_active }
			}
			eir_conq_launch_1_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

			wrathful = minor_stress_impact_gain

		}
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_conq_resolve_modifier years = 12 }
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain

			modifier = {

			}
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = patient
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0622.b
		stress_impact = {
			wrathful = minor_stress_impact_loss
			vengeful = minor_stress_impact_loss
			patient = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_vowed_vengeance years = 15 }
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_oath_to_reclaim years = 15 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_hill_war_modifier years = 10 }
		add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_hunter track = hunter value = 25 }
		add_stress = minor_stress_gain
		ai_chance = {

				add = 25
				has_trait = vengeful
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = brave
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0622.c
		trigger = {
			piety >= 100
		}
		stress_impact = {
			zealous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			cynical = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_piety = major_piety_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_saints_blessing_modifier years = 8 }
		capital_county ?= { change_county_control = medium_county_control_gain }
		add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_mystic value = 20 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				add = 25
				has_trait = zealous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0622.d
		stress_impact = {
			craven = minor_stress_impact_loss
			brave = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		random_list = {
			40 = {
				desc = eir.out.c2e
				modifier = {
					add = 20
					diplomacy >= 14
				}
				remove_short_term_gold = medium_gold_value
				random_sub_realm_county = {
					limit = { has_county_modifier = eir_ravaged_modifier }
					remove_county_modifier = eir_ravaged_modifier
				}
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
			}
			60 = {
				desc = eir.out.c2f

			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				has_trait = craven
			}
		}
	}
}

eir.0623 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0623.t
	desc = eir.0623.desc
	theme = war
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_conqueror
		animation = personality_bold
	}

	trigger = {
		has_global_variable = eir_conq_active
		is_at_war = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		var:eir_conq_lord_var ?= {
			save_scope_as = eir_conqueror
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0623.a
		stress_impact = {
			callous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			sadistic = minor_stress_impact_loss
			compassionate = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		random_sub_realm_county = {
			limit = { is_coastal_county = yes }
			add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_scorched_earth_modifier years = 3 }
		}
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_hill_war_modifier years = 3 }
		add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_hunter track = hunter value = 20 }
		add_stress = minor_stress_gain
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = callous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0623.b
		trigger = {
			gold >= 300
		}
		stress_impact = {
			greedy = minor_stress_impact_loss
			generous = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = 300
		spawn_army = {
			levies = 0
			men_at_arms = {
				type = armored_footmen
				stacks = 5
			}
			location = capital_province
			origin = capital_province
			inheritable = no
			name = eir_gallowglass_company_name
		}
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0623.c
		trigger = {
			piety >= 80
		}
		stress_impact = {
			zealous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			cynical = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_piety = medium_piety_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_saints_blessing_modifier years = 4 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_shield_wall_modifier years = 2 }
		add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_mystic value = 20 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				add = 25
				has_trait = zealous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0623.d
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			prowess >= 12
			has_trait = brave
			}
		}
		stress_impact = {
			brave = minor_stress_impact_loss
			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		random_list = {
			45 = {
				desc = eir.out.c2g
				modifier = {
					add = 30
					prowess >= 18
				}
				scope:eir_conqueror = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_host_demoralised_modifier years = 2 } }
				add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
				add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_blademaster value = 40 }
			}
			55 = {
				desc = eir.out.c2h
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
				add_stress = minor_stress_gain
				increase_wounds_effect = { REASON = fight }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				add = 25
				has_trait = brave
			}
		}
	}
}

eir.0624 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_active }
			if = {
				limit = { is_at_war = no }
				eir_conq_clear_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event = { id = eir.0624 days = 365 }
			}
		}
	}
}

eir.0625 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		eir_conq_pick_2_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:eir_conqueror
				exists = scope:eir_conq_title
				eir_conq_target_trigger = yes
				NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_active }
			}
			eir_conq_launch_2_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

eir.0630 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0630.t
	desc = eir.0630.desc
	theme = war
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_conqueror
		animation = personality_bold
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_conq_ready_trigger = yes
		current_year >= 1000
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_3 }
		has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_2
		any_ruler = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		eir_conq_pick_3_effect = yes
		set_global_variable = eir_conq_done_3
		set_global_variable = { name = eir_conq_cooldown days = 14600 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0630.a
		stress_impact = {
			brave = minor_stress_impact_loss
			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		eir_conq_launch_3_effect = yes
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_shield_wall_modifier years = 3 }
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				has_trait = brave
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = wrathful
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0630.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			diplomacy >= 11
			has_trait = gregarious
			has_trait = honest
			}
		}
		stress_impact = {
			patient = minor_stress_impact_loss
			wrathful = minor_stress_impact_gain
			impatient = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		random_list = {
			45 = {
				desc = eir.out.c3a
				modifier = {
					add = 25
					diplomacy >= 14
				}
				add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_foreknowledge_modifier years = 4 }
				trigger_event = { id = eir.0635 days = 1000 }
			}
			55 = {
				desc = eir.out.c3b
				eir_conq_launch_3_effect = yes
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
				scope:eir_conqueror = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_conqueror_emboldened_modifier years = 4 } }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = gregarious
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = patient
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0630.c
		trigger = {
			gold >= 800
		}
		stress_impact = {
			brave = minor_stress_impact_gain
			craven = minor_stress_impact_loss
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = 800
		add_prestige = major_prestige_loss
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_conq_tributary_modifier years = 10 }
		add_stress = minor_stress_gain
		ai_chance = {
			base = 6
			modifier = {
				add = 25
				has_trait = craven
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0630.d
		trigger = {
			eir_stage3_trigger = yes
		}
		stress_impact = {
			shrewd = minor_stress_impact_loss
			trusting = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		eir_conq_launch_3_effect = yes
		eir_vassal_opinion_effect = { MODIFIER = eir_allied_kings_opinion OPINION = 5 }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_allied_kings_modifier years = 5 }
		spawn_army = {
			levies = 1800
			men_at_arms = {
				type = light_footmen
				stacks = 3
			}
			location = capital_province
			origin = capital_province
			inheritable = no
			name = eir_allied_kings_host_name
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 45
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = gregarious
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = shrewd
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0630.e
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			martial >= 12
			has_trait = brave
			}
		}

eir.0640 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0640.t
	desc = eir.0640.desc
	theme = war
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_conqueror
		animation = personality_bold
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_conq_ready_trigger = yes
		current_year >= 1050
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_4 }
		has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_3
		any_ruler = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_north_germanic }
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		eir_conq_pick_4_effect = yes
		set_global_variable = eir_conq_done_4
		set_global_variable = { name = eir_conq_cooldown days = 14600 }
	}

		name = eir.0640.a

			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain

				trigger_event = { id = eir.0645 days = 1000 }
			}

				desc = eir.out.c4b
				eir_conq_launch_4_effect = yes

			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = gregarious
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = patient
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

		trigger = {
			gold >= 800

eir.0654 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_active }
			if = {
				limit = { is_at_war = no }
				eir_conq_clear_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event = { id = eir.0654 days = 365 }
			}
		}
	}
}

eir.0655 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		eir_conq_pick_5_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:eir_conqueror
				exists = scope:eir_conq_title
				eir_conq_target_trigger = yes
				NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_active }
			}
			eir_conq_launch_5_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
